text:
Claire Li: Quick heads-up — PartnerCloud PM asked for a tiny reference iac skeleton we can hand off to their marketplace team. Goal: a minimal Terraform module + example app that demonstrates marketplace listing + single-node GPU deploy (arm64 + x86 variants). Keep it super small, docs + smoke CI.
Ravi Patel: Sounds fine. Do we want to fork refkit or make a new slim repo? My vote: new repo that imports common refkit modules to keep maintenance low.
Diego Morales: I can draft the HCL skeleton today. Key constraints: one module (marketplace_shim), example under /examples/fastapi, and a single smoke CI workflow. No provider tricks.
Maya Chen: Also add KMS integration example and a sample logging/audit sink. Partner asked to see the KMS resource block for their compliance review.
Claire Li: Exactly. Target deliverables: README (how to run locally + how to publish to PartnerCloud marketplace), module docs, smoke CI, and a tiny FastAPI app that calls the model endpoint (fake stub ok).
Ravi Patel: Proposed repo layout:
- modules/marketplace_shim/{main.tf,variables.tf,outputs.tf}
- examples/fastapi/{app.py,requirements.txt}
- ci/smoke.yml (runs terraform init/apply with tiny vars)
- docs/README.md
Diego Morales: Draft main.tf snippet (will keep minimal):
```
# modules/marketplace_shim/main.tf
terraform {
  required_providers {
    partner = {
      source  = "partnercloud/partner"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}
resource "partner_marketplace_listing" "this" {
  name        = var.name
  image       = var.image
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  region      = var.region
}
output "listing_id" { value = partner_marketplace_listing.this.id }
```
Maya Chen: Nice. For KMS:
```
resource "partner_key" "model_kms" {
  purpose = "ENCRYPTION"
}
```
Keep it optional via var.enable_kms = false by default.
Claire Li: Good call on defaults. Partner also asked for both ARM64 and x86 AMI examples — we can do a simple map var inst_type_map = { arm = "c7g.large" x86 = "c6i.large" } and select by var.arch.
Ravi Patel: Linting + quality: include a .tflint.hcl and run tflint + terraform fmt in CI. Add a small smoke test that deploys the module with minimal vars then runs a curl against the example app.
Diego Morales: I'll push a PR with the initial module and example app tomorrow. Will tag @Maya and @Claire for review. :rocket:
partner-bot: Checklist link: https://redwood-internal/partner-checklists/marketplace-iac-slim (auto-post)
Maya Chen: Also add a short matrix in README for supported partner regions, CPU/GPU SKU mapping, and known limitations. Partner asked to avoid GPUs that need specialized drivers.
Claire Li: Can we also include a tiny onboarding note for their SI: "How to fork -> publish -> notify Redwood for verification"? They want a one-page runbook.
Ravi Patel: Yes. I'll draft the runbook section. We should include a NOTE about version pinning for provider and module semver.
Diego Morales: PR link will be posted here when ready. Quick reminder: keep examples under 200 lines of HCL and no heavyweight dependencies in the example app. :eyes:
Claire Li: Perfect. Thanks all — look forward to the PR. If partner wants a live walkthrough we can schedule a 30m pairing session after PR review.
